entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.
In view of provision of Section 17(4) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 the summoning for vicarious liability can only be after the evidence has commenced.

Thus initial summoning of a Director for vicarious liability in absence of allegation of individual role and when the allegation is only against the company which has nominated a person to represent it, is not called for.
Accordingly, the summoning of the appellants shall stand quashed without prejudice to their being summoned under Section 17(4) of the Act at an appropriate stage, if necessary and warranted.
The appeal is disposed of in above terms.

...................J. [ADARSH KUMAR GOEL] NEW DELHI ...................J. 23rd October, 2017 [UDAY UMESH LALIT]
